title: SmashMC.eu
description: Experience Smash with over 40 characters and 50 unique items! Can you prove your skills in our exclusive Smash mode? With a friendly community, events, and even giveaways, the fun is sure to never end.
body:
![SmashMC.eu banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5f39d79fa2a4aac47fa5d2dc9913d71b9f1e236.png)
## About us
We are the Minecraft server where you can play Smash!  
Yes, that’s right - Smash, like the game on the Switch!

## Smash: Our core Gamemode

There are over 40 unique characters, such as Mario with his stomp attack or Hulk, who is so strong that he can even carry two special items at the same time. Combined with more than 50 powerful super items, like a rocket launcher or a tornado, this creates the perfect Minecraft minigame experience.

## What else do we offer?
In addition to the standard Smash mode, we also offer a GunGame variant, Classic, Molecraft, and several lobby minigames like Ware, Dropper or even Tower Defense.

Try it yourself and smash your opponents off the map!

## How do I connect?

Java-Edition Server IP:

```
play.smashmc.eu
```
